bio: Against the backdrop of Centurion Club’s 18 th Green, Afternoon Tea is served in the Restaurant’s elegant, light-filled garden room. Walls adorned with floral decoration and lush green plants, make it the perfect place to enjoy a leisurely afternoon. And in the summer months, there is the option to dine on the restaurant terrace, which offers uninterrupted views across the lake. Head Chef, Calvin Hill has created a Afternoon Tea menus inspired by the seasons with three to choose from, including traditional, vegetarian and vegan. Each feature a selection of finger sandwiches, with a range of delicious fillings from Gin Cired Seatrout and Free Range Egg Mayonnaise to Coastal Cheddar with Spring Onion. Scones are served with Strawberry Preserve & Cornish Clotted Cream and are followed by an exquisite selection of delicate cakes and pastries. You can expect Strawberry Layer Cake, Mango & Passion Fruit Choux and a Chocolate & Banana Delice.  As the perfect accompaniment you are invited to choose from a wide range of Newby speciality teas and infusions, including The Centurion Blend, Lapsang Souchong and Milk Oolong.  Afternoon Tea at Centurion Club is priced from £30 per person and is served Tuesday to Friday from 12.30pm to 4pm and Saturday from 12pm to 4.30pm.  Centurion Club is located just 35 minutes from Central London, close to the M1 Junction 8, west of St. Albans.
